Peppermint Cappuccino
By: Carrie Barr
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 12:47pm

Ingredients




1 small peppermint patty unwrapped, quartered
2 teaspoons milk
1 cup hot brewed coffee

Preparation

1 In a large microwave-safe mug place peppermint patty pieces and milk. 2 Microwave for 30 seconds or until candy is melted and smooth when stirred. Stir in hot coffee until mug is almost full. 3 Top with whipped cream, if desired. Serve immediately.
